pairs.zh: 问得好。这个问题可以从几个角度来看。（提示：Good question; a few ways to look at）
pairs.en: Good question. There are a few ways to look at it.

pairs.zh: 这个问题没有唯一的正确答案。（提示：no single; right answer; here）
pairs.en: There's no single right answer here.

pairs.zh: 下面是一个简要的概述。（提示：Here's; quick overview）
pairs.en: Here's a quick overview.

pairs.zh: 我带你一步步过一遍。（提示：walk you through）
pairs.en: Let me walk you through it.

pairs.zh: 我们一步一步拆开来看。（提示：break it down; step by step）
pairs.en: Let's break it down step by step.

pairs.zh: 我的建议是这样的。（提示：Here's; what 从句; I'd）
pairs.en: Here's what I'd suggest.

pairs.zh: 换句话说，你不必一次全做完。（提示：In other words; don't have to; all at once）
pairs.en: In other words, you don't have to do it all at once.

pairs.zh: 比如，你可以从每天十分钟开始。（提示：For example; could start with）
pairs.en: For example, you could start with ten minutes a day.

pairs.zh: 把它当成一种习惯，而不是一项任务。（提示：Think of it as）
pairs.en: Think of it as a habit, not a task.

pairs.zh: 主要区别在于你多久用一次。（提示：main difference; how often）
pairs.en: The main difference is how often you use it.

pairs.zh: 大多数人就是卡在这里。（提示：This is where; get stuck）
pairs.en: This is where most people get stuck.

pairs.zh: 所以每天做一点会有帮助。（提示：That's why; it helps to）
pairs.en: That's why it helps to do a little every day.

pairs.zh: 说到底，关键在于练习。（提示：In the end; comes down to）
pairs.en: In the end, it comes down to practice.

pairs.zh: 结果发现，问题比我想的简单得多。（提示：It turns out; much simpler than）
pairs.en: It turns out the problem was much simpler than I thought.

pairs.zh: 它是这样运作的。（提示：Here's; how 从句）
pairs.en: Here's how it works.

pairs.zh: 话虽如此，还是有几点需要记住。（提示：That said; keep in mind）
pairs.en: That said, there are a few things to keep in mind.

pairs.zh: 这在大多数情况下应该行得通。（提示：should work; in most cases）
pairs.en: This should work in most cases.

pairs.zh: 不过，事情并不总是那么简单。（提示：not always; that simple; though 放句末）
pairs.en: It's not always that simple, though.

pairs.zh: 另一方面，它更花时间。（提示：On the other hand; takes）
pairs.en: On the other hand, it takes more time.

pairs.zh: 不管怎样，你都需要先备份文件。（提示：Either way; you'll need to; back up）
pairs.en: Either way, you'll need to back up your files first.

pairs.zh: 只是要注意，这可能需要一段时间。（提示：Just be aware that; might take a while）
pairs.en: Just be aware that it might take a while.

pairs.zh: 据我所知，它可以免费使用。（提示：As far as I know; free to use）
pairs.en: As far as I know, it's free to use.

pairs.zh: 我可能说错了，但我觉得那不是原因。（提示：could be wrong; I don't think; cause）
pairs.en: I could be wrong, but I don't think that's the cause.

pairs.zh: 没有更多细节的话，很难说。（提示：hard to say; without）
pairs.en: It's hard to say without more details.

pairs.zh: 速度和质量之间需要取舍。（提示：There's a trade-off between）
pairs.en: There's a trade-off between speed and quality.

pairs.zh: 一般来说，短句更容易读。（提示：In general; shorter; easier to read）
pairs.en: In general, shorter sentences are easier to read.

pairs.zh: 这不一定是坏事。（提示：not necessarily）
pairs.en: That's not necessarily a bad thing.

pairs.zh: 你最好先保存一下。（提示：might want to（委婉建议）; save your work）
pairs.en: You might want to save your work first.

pairs.zh: 解决这个问题最简单的办法是重启应用。（提示：The easiest way to ... is to; fix; restart）
pairs.en: The easiest way to fix this is to restart the app.

pairs.zh: 请确认你用的是最新版本。（提示：Make sure; you're using; latest version）
pairs.en: Make sure you're using the latest version.

pairs.zh: 如果那样不行，换个浏览器试试。（提示：If that doesn't work; a different browser）
pairs.en: If that doesn't work, try a different browser.

pairs.zh: 做完这一步，就全部搞定了。（提示：Once you've done that; all set）
pairs.en: Once you've done that, you're all set.

pairs.zh: 这一步你可以跳过，不必有顾虑。（提示：Feel free to; skip）
pairs.en: Feel free to skip this step.

pairs.zh: 换作是我，会先试最简单的方案。（提示：I'd try; simplest option）
pairs.en: I'd try the simplest option first.

pairs.zh: 你不必第一次就做对。（提示：don't have to; get it right; the first time）
pairs.en: You don't have to get it right the first time.

pairs.zh: 这由你决定。（提示：up to）
pairs.en: It's up to you.

pairs.zh: 如果拿不准，就选第一个方案。（提示：not sure; go with; first option）
pairs.en: If you're not sure, go with the first option.

pairs.zh: 慢慢来，你不必现在就决定。（提示：Take your time; don't have to; right now）
pairs.en: Take your time. You don't have to decide right now.

pairs.zh: 第一步是弄清楚是什么导致了这个问题。（提示：The first thing to do is; figure out; what's causing）
pairs.en: The first thing to do is figure out what's causing the problem.

pairs.zh: 你之后随时可以改。（提示：can always; later）
pairs.en: You can always change it later.

pairs.zh: 你能用更简单的话解释一下吗？（提示：Could you explain that; in simpler terms）
pairs.en: Could you explain that in simpler terms?

pairs.zh: 这两个词有什么区别？（提示：difference between; these two words）
pairs.en: What's the difference between these two words?

pairs.zh: 所以你的意思是我应该等一等？（提示：So you're saying）
pairs.en: So you're saying I should wait?

pairs.zh: 这样讲清楚了吗？（提示：Does that; make sense）
pairs.en: Does that make sense?

pairs.zh: 我不太确定我听懂了。你能再讲一遍吗？（提示：not sure I follow; go over that again）
pairs.en: I'm not sure I follow. Could you go over that again?

pairs.zh: 这句话有更自然的说法吗？（提示：Is there; a more natural way to say）
pairs.en: Is there a more natural way to say this?

pairs.zh: 这个句子听起来自然吗？（提示：sound natural）
pairs.en: Does this sentence sound natural?

pairs.zh: 如果你想让我讲得更详细，请告诉我。（提示：Let me know if; you'd like me to; go into more detail）
pairs.en: Let me know if you'd like me to go into more detail.

pairs.zh: 这个我不确定用英语怎么说，不过我试试。（提示：not sure how to say this; I'll try）
pairs.en: I'm not sure how to say this in English, but I'll try.

pairs.zh: 你能稍微慢一点再说一遍吗？（提示：Could you say that again; a little more slowly）
pairs.en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?

pairs.zh: 我换个说法。（提示：Let me put it; another way）
pairs.en: Let me put it another way.

pairs.zh: 我很期待周末。（提示：looking forward to）
pairs.en: I'm looking forward to the weekend.

pairs.zh: 我以前看书比现在多得多。（提示：used to（过去常常）; a lot more than I do now）
pairs.en: I used to read a lot more than I do now.

pairs.zh: 我花了一段时间才适应。（提示：It took me a while; get used to（适应））
pairs.en: It took me a while to get used to it.

pairs.zh: 结果我在家待了一整天。（提示：ended up; staying home）
pairs.en: I ended up staying home all day.

pairs.zh: 我时间不够了。（提示：ran out of）
pairs.en: I ran out of time.

pairs.zh: 我还在弄。（提示：still working on）
pairs.en: I'm still working on it.

pairs.zh: 我还没抽出时间做这件事。（提示：haven't gotten around to; yet）
pairs.en: I haven't gotten around to it yet.

pairs.zh: 我完全不知道发生了什么。（提示：have no idea; what happened）
pairs.en: I have no idea what happened.

pairs.zh: 这不是什么大事。（提示：big deal）
pairs.en: It's not a big deal.

pairs.zh: 我不是故意打断的。（提示：mean to; interrupt）
pairs.en: I didn't mean to interrupt.

pairs.zh: 我挺确定我锁门了。（提示：pretty sure; locked）
pairs.en: I'm pretty sure I locked the door.

pairs.zh: 我分辨不出区别。（提示：tell the difference）
pairs.en: I can't tell the difference.

pairs.zh: 你选哪个都没关系。（提示：doesn't matter; which one; pick）
pairs.en: It doesn't matter which one you pick.

pairs.zh: 我已经很久没有手写过东西了。（提示：It's been a while since; anything; by hand）
pairs.en: It's been a while since I wrote anything by hand.

pairs.zh: 只要你坚持下去，就能做到。（提示：As long as; keep going; get there）
pairs.en: As long as you keep going, you'll get there.

pairs.zh: 我很想去，但我已经有安排了。（提示：I'd love to; already have plans）
pairs.en: I'd love to, but I already have plans.

pairs.zh: 我要迟到了，十分钟后到。（提示：running late; I'll be there; in ten minutes）
pairs.en: I'm running late. I'll be there in ten minutes.

pairs.zh: 我试试看。（提示：give it a try）
pairs.en: I'll give it a try.

pairs.zh: 这倒提醒我了，我得给我妈打个电话。（提示：That reminds me; call my mom）
pairs.en: That reminds me, I need to call my mom.

pairs.zh: 我正要走。（提示：about to）
pairs.en: I'm about to leave.

pairs.zh: 难怪你累了。（提示：No wonder）
pairs.en: No wonder you're tired.
